Direct bulk route used because Wizard tool caps calls at 100 URLs. Notification coverage 40,170/40,170. Receipts speech-site/deployment/ask-answer-all-indexnow-20261004*.json. Receipt does not establish recrawl, indexing, ranking, AI citation or leads; no general direct OpenAI/Claude indexing endpoint was used.
